written.headline: Ethan Mollick: Small AI Teams at Big Firms Doing Work of Dozens, Sparking Management Conflicts
written.summary: Wharton professor Ethan Mollick reports that large manufacturers and financial services firms have scattered teams of two to three people using AI to complete the work of dozens in a fraction of the time, triggering internal management disputes over organizational implications.

written.headline: Tidal bans fully AI-generated music starting December 9 after 43% of uploads flagged as AI
written.summary: Tidal announced it will remove all fully AI-generated tracks from its platform beginning December 9, deleting more than 29 million songs. The company said 43% of tracks distributed over the past 90 days were fully AI-generated, rising to over 60% on November 6 alone.

written.headline: Nvidia CEO Jensen Huang apologizes for code of conduct violations at first all-hands since return
written.summary: Nvidia CEO Jensen Huang apologized to employees at his first all-hands meeting since being reinstated, acknowledging he made 'very serious personal mistakes' and violated the company's code of conduct. The board reinstated him 11 days after accepting his resignation over concerns about extramarital affairs.

written.headline: Three xAI founders launch Epochal to build AI agents for superhuman prediction
written.summary: Three founding members of xAI — Guodong Zhang, Zihang Dai, and Manuel Kroiss — launched Epochal, a startup building AI agents that aim to achieve superhuman prediction. Zhang is personally investing $100 million in the company, which debuted its first product, Time Portal, an archived web environment for training agents on historical data.

written.headline: Anthropic shares fall below $83 IPO price after record debut
written.summary: Anthropic shares dropped below their $83 IPO price on Tuesday, trading as low as $76, a roughly 12% decline from Monday's close. The stock had debuted at $111.50 last week in the largest AI offering ever.

written.headline: iFood scales coding agents across 15,000 repositories
written.summary: OpenAI reports that Brazilian food delivery company iFood has scaled coding agents across 15,000 repositories.
